main_result: Explicit two-generated C-prime(1/6) groups with sufficiently abundant prime-order detours have fixed price one in every free p.m.p. action.
main_proof_dependencies: finite union probability and paid repair
critical_audit_points: Identical proper-power rotations are deduplicated as words before checking pieces.
The exact orders are prime, which makes the cyclic-intersection argument elementary.
The finite partition separates the identity as well as every detour coordinate.
Failures are repaired at every root, including partition-collision exceptions.
Each positive epsilon gets a separately generating finite graphing; no limiting graph is assumed connected.
The full b-transformation costs one; a is retained only on a small measurable domain.
The groups are not bounded-exponent Burnside groups.
Percolation is an application of cited existing results, not a new proof of universal separation.
Continuum markings imply continuum unmarked groups because a countable group has only countably many generating pairs.
prior_nodes: Retained without blanket revalidation; not assumptions in the new proof.
